req.title: Set cookie via path
req.statement: The system shall set a cookie of name=<name>, value=<value> and redirect to /cookies when GET /cookies/set/<name>/<value> is called.

doc.reasoning: The requirement mandates that GET /cookies/set/<name>/<value> sets a cookie and issues a 302 redirect to /cookies. Tests must verify: (1) positive path — correct 302 status, Set-Cookie header with exact name/value, Location header pointing to /cookies; (2) negative path — missing path segments yield 404; (3) boundary — single-character name/value, empty-string-like minimal values, and special characters. Mutation resilience is achieved by asserting exact status codes (302 not 301/303), exact Location header value, exact cookie name and value in Set-Cookie header, and verifying the redirect target is precisely /cookies.

tests.name: test_set_cookie_via_path_positive_standard
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Create Flask test client with allow_redirects=False
trace: R-HTTPBIN-030: set cookie via path -> 302 redirect to /cookies with Set-Cookie
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app

def test_set_cookie_via_path_positive_standard():
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.get('/cookies/set/testname/testvalue', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r.status_code == 302
    location = r.headers.get('Location', '')
    assert location == '/cookies'
    set_cookie = r.headers.get('Set-Cookie', '')
    assert 'testname=testvalue' in set_cookie

test_set_cookie_via_path_positive_standard()

from httpbin.core import app
import json

def test_set_cookie_via_path_cookie_persists_after_redirect():
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.get('/cookies/set/session_key/session_val', follow_redirects=True)
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = json.loads(r.data)
    assert 'cookies' in body
    assert body['cookies'].get('session_key') == 'session_val'

tests.name: test_set_cookie_via_path_negative_missing_both_segments
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: GET /cookies/set (no name or value path segments)
expected: HTTP 200 from /cookies/set query-string endpoint (different route), not 302 from set_cookie handler
trace: R-HTTPBIN-030: /cookies/set without path params routes to set_cookies, not set_cookie
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app

def test_set_cookie_via_path_negative_missing_both_segments():
    client = app.test_client()
    # /cookies/set with no path params hits the query-string variant, not set_cookie
    r = client.get('/cookies/set', follow_redirects=False)
    # The query-string variant also redirects to /cookies (302)
    # but the set_cookie path handler is NOT invoked
    # Confirm no Set-Cookie with empty name is issued
    set_cookie = r.headers.get('Set-Cookie', '')
    assert 'None' not in set_cookie
    # Status should be 302 (query-string variant) not 500
    assert r.status_code in (200, 302)

test_set_cookie_via_path_negative_missing_both_segments()
